meta.scope: First standardized on-play injury announcement per player per regular-season game; not all injuries.
meta.source: nflverse play-by-play, 2017–2025; descriptions attributed to the injured team.
meta.bootstrap: Whole-game resampling stratified by season and whether the selected team played; 5,000 draws per filter, 10,000 for the primary full-era SF comparison.
meta.quarter_counts_note: Overtime kept separate from regulation shares.
meta.missingness_note: 2024: 119 of 609 player-game pairs with standardized return updates have no recorded initial announcement in that game.
